gloss: information board; guide board; directory sign

definitions.gloss: information board; guide board; directory sign
definitions.explanation: A board or sign that provides directions, maps, or information to visitors. Commonly found at stations, parks, tourist spots, and public buildings.

examples.japanese: {案内|あんない}{板|ばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{案内|あんない}{板|ばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a large information board in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {案内|あんない}{板|ばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦ハイキング→ハイキング：03869_haikingu⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the hiking course by looking at the map on the information board.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧ (guidance/information) + {板|ばん} (board/panel). These boards are ubiquitous in Japan, found at train stations, tourist attractions, parks, shopping malls, and building lobbies. They often include detailed maps with current-location markers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {案内|あんない}{板|ばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at the information board
- {案内|あんない}{板|ばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install an information board
- ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧{案内|あんない}{板|ばん}: tourist information board
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{案内|あんない}{板|ばん}: electronic information display

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{案内|あんない}{図|ず}→案内図：17781_annaizu⟧: information map/diagram — a printed map rather than a board
- ⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧: sign/signboard — more general, includes shop signs and billboards
- ⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧: bulletin board — for posted notices, not directional guidance
